name: savusd-usdc
notes: admin is a temporary operator key; it hands over to the final admin with the pool's two-step propose_admin/accept_admin transfer.
pool: arguments to PoolFactory.deploy (salt is chosen at deploy time). oracle is the dedicated pool_oracle_adapter, deployed first.
min_collateral is in oracle base units; the pool only leaves setup with a 7-decimal oracle, so 100000000000 = 10,000 USD.

reserves: ReserveConfig arguments to queue_set_reserve, in index order. Both assets are classic-asset SACs with 7 decimals: USDC issuer GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN, savUSD issuer GBCSESJONU4FJGIRC4UTDHQFE43IL4U4I4HP5JKPKAJVNMQO76672MJJ.
usdc IRM at ir_mod = 1: 2% at U=0, 6.5% at 90%, 10.2% at 92%, 15.75% at 95%, 25% at 100%. savusd is collateral only (l_factor 0); r_base 1000 is the contract minimum.

Immutable after setup: update_pool is disabled and, once the pool leaves status 6, queue_set_reserve only accepts disabling a reserve. Caps, IRM, factors, max_positions and min_collateral are permanent.
set_status 0 checks the backstop threshold; it is met by this pool's own activation stack (own factory, Comet, emissions-disabled backstop and synthetic no-value BLND/USDC legs), not real capital.
